title: Dispute, review and submission schemas have additional workflow/field-rule deviations requiring contract tests

original_titles.title: Report field limits deviate from spec on both client and server (WS-04a S1-part)
WS-04 field-rule deviations and missing affordances

problem: The audit reports remaining field-rule, dispute and response-shape deviations. Some may be stale after the four-level flow rewrite; they need current contract-level reproduction rather than carrying forward historical line-specific claims.
impact: A stale spec mismatch can be mistaken for a live defect, while a real request-limit mismatch may permit oversized reports or make participant submissions fail unexpectedly.

verification.basis: Current source inspection at the main-branch commit listed in metadata. Original audit line numbers are treated as historical and were not reused as current line references.

implementation_steps.action: Create a table for each submission/report field containing client constraint, server Pydantic constraint, DB column constraint, maximum size and error code.
Run boundary tests at min/max and one below/above for strings, arrays, line spans, file paths, artifact metadata and report counts.
Map dispute create/status/resolution payloads to the currently implemented four-level model and update or formally waive obsolete v1 contract expectations.
Align error status codes and frontend validation messages to the server schema; do not duplicate limits without shared constants or generated types.

acceptance_criteria: Every field has identical client/server/documented limits.
Invalid input is rejected deterministically before DB mutation.
Every contract deviation is fixed or explicitly waived.
regression_tests: Add a focused failing test before implementation where practical.
Add a negative authorization / boundary test, not only a happy-path test.
Run the affected backend/frontend suite and the full CI workflow before merge.
